context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75 verified navigation active highlight and microcopy CTAs. Key findings: (1) Desktop navigation uses isActive() function with useLocation() to determine active state. Active links get 'text-[#FFBE98]' (peach color) + underline via 'after:absolute after:bottom-[-4px]...'. (2) Mobile navigation uses mobileNavClass() with 'text-[#FFBE98] border-l-2 border-[#FFBE98] pl-3' for active state. (3) 'Viagem Principal' button has permanent peach style (bg-[#FFBE98]) and is not affected by active state logic. (4) '/plan-trip' check also covers '/travel-planner' routes via startsWith(). (5) Microcopy CTAs in TravelPlanner.js include 'Evita filas', 'Muito procurado', 'Esgota rapido', 'Reservar experiências' etc. in ACTIVITY_PATTERNS and getCTACopy function. (6) IfthenPay payment integration is MOCKED.
